| # Object 0x13FE configuration valid {#object-0x13fe-configuration-valid-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                                          |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object shall contain an acknowledgment flag for a valid configuration. After write access to any of the safety-relevant parameter,

this object shall be set to invalid configuration. After finalization the configuration has to be set to valid.

  Index           0x13FE
  --------------- ----------------------------------------
  Name            Configuration valid
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 8
  Category        Mandatory
  Access          RW (only in NMT state pre-operational)
  PDO Mapping     No
  Value Range     See below
  Default Value   0

 

Value definitions:

0xA5 : Configuration valid.

All other values shall indicate an invalid configuration.
